description: T-3467: a formula stored without the dynamic-array flag (legacy, no cm) that references a spill. A1 =SEQUENCE(3) spills A1:A3. C2 and C5 hold the legacy =SIN(A1#), on and off the spill's rows; D2 and D5 the legacy plain-range control =SIN(A1:A3). Intersection would give SIN(2) on row 2 and #VALUE! on row 5; a spill would fill C3:C4 (resp. C6:C7), read by the ISBLANK cells; plain #VALUE! is #VALUE! in both. The FORMULATEXT cells show whether Excel adds an @.
